# dsh-skills
English | 中文
A **技能 / Skills** row in the DeepSeek Harness left navigation, and the page it opens.

Install · Download v0.1.0 ·
Landing page (`github.io` is unreachable on some networks — see below)

DSH discovers Agent Skills from `.dsh/skills` and `.agents/skills` — under your
home and under a pro

ject — but ships no surface for seeing what is installed or
for turning one off without editing file
s. This plugin adds that surface.
## What the panel does
| **See everything** | Every root DSH scans, with each skill's name, description, instruction path a

nd invocation policy. |
| **Preview** | The full `SKILL.md`, frontmatter and body, without leaving t

he app. |
| **Enable / disable** | A switch per skill. Disabled skills keep their bytes and stay on

disk. |
| **Install** | Copy a folder that has `SKILL.md` at its top level into the root you pick. T

he original is never moved. |
| **Import from GitHub** | Paste a GitHub repository, tree, or skill l
ink. One repository can contribute several skills in one batch; conflicts and oversized bundles reje

ct the whole batch without overwriting. |
| **New skill** | Write a bundle with a valid frontmatter

block from a form. |
| **Uninstall safely** | Uninstall moves the entry to a root-local `.trash`; re

store it later, or delete it for good. |
| **Locate** | Reveal a skill or a root in Finder / Explore

r / the desktop file manager. |
| **Known libraries** | Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy
keep their skills in well-known places; those that exist are listed automatically, each with that ag

ent's mark. |
| **Add a directory** | Point the panel at another agent's skill library — `~/.claude/
skills`, a colleague's checkout, a shared bundle. Its skills are listed, managed in place, and loade
eague's checkout, a shared bundle. Its skills are listed, managed in place, and loaded by DSH too. |
## Install

**From GitHub.** This repository is a ready-to-install package: `package.json`
sits at the root and

there is no build step, so any npm-compatible git spec
resolves. In the plugin manager (Settings → P

resolves. In the plugin manager (Settings → Plugins), install:

The same spec works from the CLI — `dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm
inside the profile:

`https://github.com/yixin2021/dsh-skills` and
`git+ssh://git@github.com/yixin2021/dsh-skills.git` ar

`git+ssh://git@github.com/yixin2021/dsh-skills.git` are equivalent.
**From a local checkout.**

The bundle patch inserts one Loader row named `skills`; the client half mounts
the navigation row an
d the panel. Reload the window after installing.
## How it works

**Host half** (`index.js`) registers one authenticated JSON route,
`POST /api/dsh-skills`, on `ctx.c

onnection.fetch`. It answers `list`, `read`,
`set-disabled`, `trash`, `restore`, `purge`, `empty-tra

sh`, `create`,
`import-directory`, `import-files`, `install-from-remote`, `reveal`, `add-root`
and `

remove-root`. `ctx.skills.registerProvider` publishes the
discovered libraries and the added directo

ries to the model. `lib/skills-core.js` owns the
skill grammar — frontmatter parsing, root discovery

, entry scanning — so the
route and the tests agree on what a skill is.

**Client half** (`client.js`) registers a `sidebar.panellist` icon under the id
`dsh-skills` and the

`main` panel keyed by that same id, which is how the layout
addresses a panel. It never reads a ski

ll root itself: every fact arrives
through the route, so the browser has no filesystem authority.
### Importing from GitHub

A skill that lives in a GitHub repository is one directory bundle: `<dir>/SKILL.md`
plus whatever it

references. Paste a GitHub link and the panel reads the archive,
shows the skills it finds, and let

s you select one or several for a single import.
The Host validates every selected bundle before wri

ting any of them: an existing
name, an invalid path, or a size/file-count limit rejects the whole ba

tch without
overwriting or leaving a partial install.
| Link | How it is read |

| `https://github.com/owner/repo` | The archive service — one request, no rate limit. |
| `https://g

ithub.com/owner/repo/tree/main/skills/foo` | The same, narrowed to that directory. |
| `https://gitl

ab.com/owner/repo/-/tree/main/skills/foo` | Cloned, then narrowed. |
| `https://gitee.com/owner/repo

/tree/main/skills/foo` | Cloned, then narrowed. |
| `git@host:owner/repo.git` | Cloned over SSH. |
|
`https://host/owner/repo.git#branch` | Cloned at that branch. |

GitHub has an archive endpoint that answers with the whole tree in one request
and no rate limit, so

it is read that way; every other git host is cloned,
shallowly, into a temporary directory that is

deleted as soon as the tree has
been read. Both paths end in the same tree, and `lib/skill-tree.js`

owns the
policy both obey: which directory holds a `SKILL.md`, which files belong to it,
and which p
aths may become a file name.

A repository that holds several skills is a catalogue. The dialog shows checkboxes,
starts with all

visible candidates selected, and supports selecting or clearing
all. If more than 40 candidates are

found, the dialog reports the total and
suggests narrowing the GitHub link to a subdirectory. A bran

ch whose name
contains a slash (`release/2.0`) is resolved by trying the possible branch/path
splits
until the requested directory is found.

**A private repository** needs an access token. The dialog has a field for one,
and it is optional:

a public repository never carries a token, so none is sent.
The token is used for that one download

and is never written to disk. For a git
clone it travels in the child's environment rather than in t

he command line,
[该节后续省略]
### Disabling without deleting

DSH only discovers *direct children* of a skill root. A disabled skill is moved
to `<root>/.disabled

/<name>` — hidden, therefore invisible to every provider —
and moved back untouched when re-enabled.

Nothing in `SKILL.md` is rewritten,
[该节后续省略]
